items.originalTitle: "A big mistake" - Devastated Franco Colapinto apologises to Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris for Baku F1 crash
items.summaryEn: Alpine driver Franco Colapinto has apologised for the "big mistake" that knocked out his team-mate Pierre Gasly and McLaren's Lando Norris at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
detailZh: "一个重大失误"——弗朗哥·科拉平托为巴库F1撞车事件向皮埃尔·加斯利和兰多·诺里斯道歉，深感懊悔
弗朗哥·科拉平托承担了责任，他在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛上撞掉了阿尔派队友皮埃尔·加斯利和迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯
阿尔派车手弗朗哥·科拉平托为此道歉，称这是一个"重大失误"，这次失误导致队友皮埃尔·加斯利和迈凯伦车手兰多·诺里斯在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛中被撞出比赛。
在巴库街道赛道第36圈的重启中，科拉平托在抓地力很低的内侧线路驶入一号弯时，冷态前轮抱死，撞上了加斯利的赛车侧面，诺里斯也在这次事故中被殃及。
这次事故让阿尔派失去了大把积分，因为它的两位车手原本都在前十名之内，而这也为诺里斯一个令人沮丧的下午画上了句号，他呼吁国际汽联用禁赛处罚来惩治粗心驾驶。
事后，科拉平托对自己造成的损失深感崩溃，并向他的车队、加斯利和诺里斯频频道歉。
"就是一个大失误，"这位阿根廷车手说。"我的轮胎和刹车都是冷的，完全锁死了，车子完全失控。所以，除了向车队、当然还有向皮埃尔、向工厂的所有人道歉之外，没有太多可说的了。
"我们一直在非常努力地争取积分，而我却因为那个大失误把一切葬送了。所以，我为车队感到非常难过。当然，这非常令人失望。"
“我们和皮埃尔谈过了，他回来后当然非常沮丧，但我会试着再次和他谈谈。”
当被问及诺里斯曾呼吁对他实施一场禁赛时，科拉平托回答道：“说实话，我也要向兰多道歉，不仅仅是皮埃尔。向所有人道歉，这当然是个重大失误。我只是刹车抱死了，然后车子完全失控。我什么都做不了。刚一踩刹车就抱死了，损失了很多。
科拉平托承认，撞掉自己的队友违反了车队内部不成文的规矩，这让这次事故变得更加严重，他还表示自己预计会收到国际汽联比赛干事的处罚。
“撞掉自己的队友，这更让人失望。这是最糟糕的部分。”他补充道。
“如果只影响到我自己，那当作教训也没什么，但当它还影响到另一辆车时，情况就更糟了。我当然期待会有一些处罚结果。我说不好，我又不是赛事干事，所以就把这事交给他们吧。”
detailEn: "A big mistake" - Devastated Franco Colapinto apologises to Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris for Baku F1 crash
Franco Colapinto has taken responsibility for taking out Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly and McLaren's Lando Norris at Formula 1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix
Alpine driver Franco Colapinto has apologised for the "big mistake" that saw him knock team-mate Pierre Gasly and McLaren driver Lando Norris out of F1's Azerbaijan GP.

On a lap 36 restart in the streets of Baku, Colapinto locked up his cold front tyres on the low-grip inside line into Turn 1 and clattered into the side of Gasly, with Norris also collected in the incident.

The incident cost Alpine a major points haul as both of its drivers were in the top 10, and it capped off a frustrating afternoon for Norris, who called on the FIA to punish careless driving with a race ban.
Afterwards, Colapinto was devastated by the damage he caused and apologised profusely to his team, to Gasly and to Norris.

"Just a big mistake,' the Argentinian said. "I locked up completely with cold tyres and cold brakes and was out of control completely. So, not a lot to say more than sorry to the team, to Pierre of course, to all the factory.
"We've been working really hard to score points and I threw it away with that big mistake. So, very sad for the team. Of course, a big disappointment."
"We spoke to Pierre, he came back and of course he's very upset, but I will try to talk to him again."

When put to him that Norris had called for a one-race ban, Colapinto replied: "Well, sorry to Lando as well, to be honest, not only Pierre. Sorry to everyone, it's a big mistake, of course. I just locked up and then I was very out of control. I couldn't do a lot. As soon as I touched the brake, I locked up and lost a lot."
Colapinto acknowledged breaking the unwritten rule of not taking out a team-mate made the incident even worse and said he was expecting to get a penalty from the FIA's race stewards.
"It is more than disappointing to take out your team-mate. That's the biggest part of it," he added.

"If it only affected me, it would be okay to learn, but when it affects the other car as well, it's even worse. I do expect to get something, of course. I don't know, I'm not a steward, so I'll leave it."
keyPointsZh: 事故发生在巴库第36圈的重启时，科拉平托在一号弯内侧低抓地力路线上锁死了冷却状态的前轮，撞上加斯利侧部，诺里斯也被波及
keyPointsEn: The incident happened on the lap 36 restart in Baku, when Colapinto locked up his cold front tyres on the low-grip inside line into Turn 1 and clattered into the side of Gasly, collecting Norris as well.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯呼吁FIA对科拉平托实施禁赛处罚
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯表示，弗朗哥·科拉平托在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中引发连环撞车导致自己、科拉平托和加斯利退赛，FIA应该对这种失误实施禁赛处罚。
items.originalTitle: Norris wants F1 race ban for Colapinto
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris says Franco Colapinto should face a Formula 1 race ban for his error in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix that eliminated Norris, Colapinto and Pierre Gasly from the race.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯表示，弗兰科·科拉平托在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中的失误导致诺里斯、科拉平托和皮埃尔·加斯利三人全部退赛，他应该被处以一级方程式禁赛一场的处罚。
在巴库比赛前30多圈相当平淡的行驶之后，科拉平托在第10位、安全车重启进1号弯时出现了严重的锁死，似乎是被前方基米·安东内利的梅赛德斯赛车的减速幅度所迷惑。
他避开了安东内利，但不得不紧贴内侧护墙，速度几乎没有降低多少，最终在刹车区撞上了阿尔派车队队友加斯利，连锁反应还连带淘汰了诺里斯。
对于这个失误，诺里斯并不买账，而他在那之前刚度过了一个相当艰难的周末，并且在安全车出现前自己也在1号弯犯了错。
诺里斯强调，他发言时还没有看过回放，但表示：“我认为国际汽联应该更严格一些，开始对这种事情直接禁赛。这就是有些人太不小心了。”
“这会损失很多钱，我所有的部件现在都进了垃圾桶。这些人应该被禁赛，因为那样的驾驶水平不配留在一级方程式。”
被问到领跑的拉塞尔在比赛重启时的做法是否把车流压得太紧时，他说：“拉塞尔想怎么做都可以。”
“在一级方程式中，我认为大家应该预料到各种情况，知道抓地力会很低，知道轮胎温度会很低——其实轮胎温度甚至没那么低。”
“在一级方程式里，你想要和世界上最出色的车手较量，而当这种事情发生时，那是因为……对，这种东西就不应该出现在赛道上。”
他后来重申，对于这种撞车行为，他希望“至少禁赛一场”。
在一级方程式中，车手要被禁赛一场，需要在12个月内累积12个罚分——而自国际汽联调整了罚分的处理方式之后，这种情况的可能性大大降低了，因为国际汽联现在只对它认定属于主动危险驾驶或违背体育道德的行为进行处罚。
由于多次违反黄旗规则，科拉平托目前在罚分榜上与卡洛斯·塞恩斯并列榜首——不过，在这次事件尚未作出裁决之前，他也仍然只有4个罚分，因此在现行制度下，没有任何先例可以让他被禁赛参加下一轮比赛。
科拉平托本人则在无线电中立刻表示了歉意，并在面对媒体时保持了这种语气。
他说：“我完全失去了控制。除了向车队、向皮埃尔、当然也向工厂的所有人道歉之外，没有太多可说的。”
“我也要向兰多道歉。我向大家道歉。这当然是一个很大的失误。”
对于诺里斯提出的禁赛建议，他没有具体回应，但表示：“我当然预计会受到某种处罚。我不知道具体会是什么，我又不是赛事干事。”
在巴库站比赛结束时，科拉平托被处以10秒处罚——但由于他未能完成比赛，这一处罚现在将被转换为发车位置退后。
detailEn: Lando Norris says Franco Colapinto should face a Formula 1 race ban for his error during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix that took Norris, Colapinto and Pierre Gasly out of the race.

After a fairly processional first 30-plus laps of the Baku race, Colapinto had a massive lock-up while entering Turn 1 on a safety car restart while running in 10th place, seemingly caught out by the rate of deceleration from the Mercedes of Kimi Antonelli ahead of him.

He avoided hitting Antonelli but instead had to hug the inside wall and never scrubbed off anywhere near enough speed, ploughing into Alpine team-mate Gasly in the braking zone, with the chain reaction also eliminating Norris.
It was an error that Norris, who had had a particularly difficult weekend up to then and had his own Turn 1 mistake just before the safety car, did not take kindly to.

Norris stressed that he had not seen the replay at the time of speaking but said: "I think the FIA should be more strict and start handing out bans for this kind of stuff. It's just careless from people.
"It costs a lot of money, all my parts are in the bin now. People should just get banned, because that's not driving that deserves to be in Formula 1."
On whether race leader George Russell's approach to the restart bunched up the field too much, he said: "George can do what he wants.
"In Formula 1 I think you expect drivers to anticipate things, know grip is going to be low, know tyre temps are low - they weren't even that low.
"In Formula 1 you want to be against the best drivers in the world, and when stuff like this happens, it's because...yeah, [it] shouldn't be there."
He reiterated later that he wanted "at least a one-race ban" for this kind of crash.

A race ban in F1 requires a driver to amass 12 penalty points in a 12-month period - which has become a lot less likely since the FIA revised its approach to penalty points, seeking only to penalise what it perceived as actively dangerous driving or unsportsmanlike conduct.

By virtue of a number of yellow flag infringements, Colapinto is joint-top with Carlos Sainz in the current penalty points leaderboard - but, pending a verdict on this incident, that still means only four points, so there is no precedent under the current system by which he would be banned for the next round.
Colapinto, for his part, was immediately apologetic on the radio and maintained that tone in his media appearance.
"I was out of control completely. Not a lot more to say than sorry to the team, to Pierre, of course, to all the factory," he said.
"I'm sorry to Lando also. I'm sorry to everyone. It was a big mistake, of course."
He didn't respond specifically to Norris's suggestion of a race ban but said: "I do expect to get something [in terms of a penalty], of course. I don't know, I'm not a steward."
A 10-second penalty was assessed against Colapinto as the Baku race concluded - but as he did not reach the finish, this is now set to be converted to a grid drop.
keyPointsZh: 事故发生在巴库比赛第30多圈后的安全车重启时，科拉平托当时位居第10，在进入一号弯时严重锁死轮胎
他似乎是受到前方安东内利的梅赛德斯减速幅度影响，虽然躲过安东内利，但在制动区撞上了队友加斯利
诺里斯本人此前度过了艰难的周末，并在安全车出现前自己也犯了一号弯失误
keyPointsEn: The crash happened on a safety car restart after 30-plus laps in Baku, with Colapinto running 10th and locking up heavily into Turn 1
He appeared caught out by the deceleration of Kimi Antonelli's Mercedes ahead, avoided Antonelli but ploughed into Alpine team-mate Gasly in the braking zone
Norris had endured a particularly difficult weekend and made his own Turn 1 mistake just before the safety car

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris: FIA should hand out race ban for Franco Colapinto's Baku F1 crash
items.summaryEn: Reigning world champion Lando Norris believes Franco Colapinto deserves at least a one-race ban for causing a pile-up at the Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix. The crash on a lap 36 restart in Baku knocked out both Norris and Colapinto's Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯：国际汽联应对弗朗哥·科拉平托在巴库F1撞车事故作出禁赛处罚
兰多·诺里斯对弗朗哥·科拉平托在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛重启时犯下的代价惨重的错误感到愤怒，该事故导致这位迈凯伦车手和科拉平托所在的阿尔派车队队友皮埃尔·加斯利双双退赛
弗朗哥·科拉平托，阿尔派，兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦，皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派
卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯表示，他认为弗朗哥·科拉平托因在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛上引发连环撞车，理应受到“至少一场比赛的禁赛”处罚。
在巴库街道赛道第36圈的重启时，科拉平托锁死了尚未升温的前轮胎，毫无方向感地在1号弯撞上了阿尔派队友加斯利，诺里斯也被卷入这两车纠缠之中。
这起事故导致加斯利和诺里斯双双退赛，为迈凯伦车手一个令人沮丧的下午画上句号——他缺乏速度，还在1号弯自己犯错，掉到了重启后的车群之中。
这次重启引发的碰撞让诺里斯怒不可遏，他认为科拉平托粗心大意的驾驶应该受到F1赛事干事严厉的处罚。
"我还没看回放。我就是被撞出去的。我认为国际汽联应该更严格一些，开始对这种行为禁赛," 诺里斯怒气冲冲地说。"这是人们粗心大意。这要花很多钱；我所有的部件现在都进了垃圾桶。这种人就该被禁赛，因为那样的驾驶不配留在一级方程式。
当被问及在湿滑的巴库赛道上发生的事故是否存在可以减轻责任的情况时，诺里斯补充道：“在一级方程式中，我认为大家会期待车手能够预判各种情况。抓地力会很低；轮胎温度会很低；甚至当时也没那么低。在一级方程式中，我们想要与世界上最优秀的车手竞争，当这种事情发生时，那是因为（他们）根本不应该出现在那里。”
“我没有看回放，但如果你在这样的重启（restart）中引发撞车，你至少应该被禁赛一场。”
科拉平托当时还激怒了队友加斯利，因为两人本来都有机会获得积分，他在事后表达了歉意。
“一次重大的失误，”这位阿根廷车手承认。“我在轮胎和刹车都冰冷的情况下完全锁死了车轮，整个人完全失控。除了向车队、当然还有向皮埃尔、以及向工厂的所有人道歉之外，没有太多可说的了。”
“我们一直非常努力地去争取积分，而我因为那个重大失误把机会葬送了。所以，我为车队感到非常难过。这当然是个巨大的失望。我也要向兰多道歉。”
detailEn: Lando Norris: FIA should hand out race ban for Franco Colapinto's Baku F1 crash
Lando Norris was furious with Franco Colapinto's costly restart error at Formula 1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix, which knocked out both the McLaren driver and Colapinto's Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly
Franco Colapinto, Alpine, Lando Norris, McLaren, Pierre Gasly, Alpine
Reigning world champion Lando Norris says he thinks Franco Colapinto deserves "at least a one-race ban" for causing a pile-up at F1's Azerbaijan GP.
On a lap 36 restart in the streets of Baku, Colapinto locked up his cold front tyres and aimlessly speared into Alpine team-mate Gasly into Turn 1, with Norris also collected by the tangling pair.

The incident knocked both Gasly and Norris out of the race, capping off a frustrating afternoon for the McLaren driver who lacked pace and made a Turn 1 mistake of his own that dropped him into the pack on the restart.
The restart clash left Norris furious, feeling Colapinto's careless driving should be punished harshly by F1's race stewards.

"I've not seen it. I just got taken out. I think the FIA should be stricter and start handing out bans for this kind of stuff," Norris vented. "It's careless from people. It costs a lot of money; all my parts are in the bin now. People should just get banned, because that's not driving that deserves to be in Formula 1.

When asked if there were mitigating circumstances for what happened on the slippery Baku circuit, Norris added: "In Formula 1, I think you expect drivers to anticipate things. Grip is going to be low; tyre temps are low; they weren't even that low. In Formula 1, we want to be against the best drivers in the world, and when stuff like this happens, it's because [they] shouldn't be there.
"I've not seen it, but if you cause a crash in a restart like this, you should have at least a one-race ban."
Colapinto, who also drew the ire of team-mate Gasly as the pair was on for points, was apologetic afterwards.

"A big mistake," the Argentinian acknowledged. "I locked up completely with cold tyres and cold brakes and was out of control completely. Not a lot to say more than sorry to the team, to Pierre of course, to all the factory.
"We've been working really hard to score points and I threw it away with that big mistake. So, I'm very sad for the team. Of course it's a big disappointment. I'm sorry to Lando as well."
